snippet.query: Should I buy a travel eSIM or a physical SIM at the airport?
snippet.exactText: A travel eSIM is useful when your phone supports it and the plan covers your trip; a physical SIM remains an option when digital installation is unavailable or a suitable local offer fits better. Choose by device compatibility, coverage, calls, validity and total trip cost, rather than assuming either format always wins.
